feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 29 September 2026 9:48pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 29 September 2026 at 9:45pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds, reaching near gale force at times.


##Synopsis##

Deepening low pressure to the west of Ireland, bringing a frontal zone across the area overnight.


##Wind##

Southeast 5 to 7, veering and decreasing south or southwest 4 or 5 occasionally 6 later in the night.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, occasionally rough in the west, becoming moderate later, but slight in Liverpool Bay.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain, turning heavy for a time, before clearing to isolated showers tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain or showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South 4 or 5 veering southwest Wednesday evening, backing South 5 or 6 later on Thursday.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, becoming fair overnight into Thursday.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.
